title: Sherman accounts of orbs and giant wolf-like creatures heading toward Dry Gulch Creek
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Sherman accounts of orbs and giant wolf-like creatures heading toward Dry Gulch Creek, about 1990s at Dry Gulch Creek, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Dry Gulch Creek, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: There had been accounts, in fact, going back to the Shermans, accounts of orbs of light traveling that direction or and and even these giant wolves, wolf-like creatures that it proceeded to head out toward that part of the ranch and disappeared.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, a property known for reports of strange events, says the stories go back to the Shermans, the family who lived there in the 1990s. According to those accounts, glowing balls of light and even giant wolf-like creatures were seen heading toward Dry Gulch Creek, a part of the ranch, and then vanishing. He tells it because it suggests that one spot on the ranch has long drawn something unusual.
